disclaimer: Evaluation measures conversational realism, technical consistency, and rubric compliance; it does not guarantee interview outcomes or superiority over human candidates.

human_naturalness.description: Sounds like natural spoken English with contractions and varied rhythm.

conversational_authenticity.description: Avoids AI clichés, STAR headings, and formulaic three-part wrappers.

question_relevance.description: Answers the exact question asked, including all parts of multi-part prompts.

information_density.description: High signal per spoken sentence without fluff or filler padding.

technical_accuracy.description: Technically sound protocols, concepts, and system behavior.

implementation_depth.description: Explains real implementation/config choices rather than textbook definitions.

numerical_accuracy.description: Directly states established or correctly computed quantities.

mathematical_consistency.description: Zero contradictions across nodes, GPUs, GPU-hours, latency deltas, and budgets.

professional_credibility.description: Realistic constraints, trade-offs, and failures rather than exaggerated wins.

employer_alignment.description: Reflects employer industry realities and valid technology chronology.

seniority_alignment.description: Ownership scope and tone match actual documented seniority.

individual_ownership.description: Clearly separates personal actions from broader team delivery.

business_judgment.description: Links technical choices to cost, risk, SLOs, and customer impact.

leadership_maturity.description: Handles disagreements, compromises, and mentoring constructively.

context_awareness.description: Preserves established facts and references prior turns cleanly.

interviewer_adaptation.description: Adjusts depth for recruiter vs specialist vs executive.

follow_up_consistency.description: Sustains coherent architecture and facts over 20+ follow-ups.

appropriate_answer_length.description: Respects dynamic spoken duration budgets for question complexity.

evidence_integrity.description: Never presents fictional simulation scenarios as verified facts in authentic prep mode.

technical_defensibility.description: Defends valid trade-offs calmly and challenges false interviewer premises.
